additional_binding_review.original_cell_incompatibility: The frozen C227853 road/depart_parked/curb cell initializes the actor on a highway curbside shoulder. The separate statutory entry movement starts outside a highway and crosses its legal boundary. Moving the start off-highway would cease to be a depart_parked/curb scene; treating the shoulder-to-lane merge as entering the highway would misstate the source fact.
additional_binding_review.required_source: Independently cited Nevada public-highway dedication and boundary record, off-highway approach status, and entry crossing in original frames.
additional_binding_review.binding_reason: C177626 is an existing paved_road/enter_road/other_vehicle motor_vehicle_driver cell. Its NRS-484B-260 witness explicitly uses a private-way origin and paved-highway entry; the same physical origin/boundary arrangement can test the separate NRS-484B-410 safety-before-entry obligation without changing either law or treating shoulder departure as entry.
required_original_evidence: cited off-highway private-way source and legal boundary
cited public-highway dedication, access and near/far boundary source
original ego footprints and timing before, at and after first highway-boundary crossing
original approaching highway traffic trajectories, surface gaps and braking observations
independent safety judgment made before movement and recorded review without numerical legal cutoff
additional_binding_review.registry_result: C177626 is actor/maneuver compatible in the existing frozen batch assignment and catalog, but C177626 is absent from inputs/coverage/candidate-cells.json. runtime/scenario_pipeline/worker_exchange/branch_coverage.py assignments() resolves every supplemental binding against that candidate registry; candidates.get(C177626) is None and the validator raises Ineligible supplemental binding. Current strict delivery cannot accept this proposal without an upstream registry/runtime change.
